name: hermes-chatgpt-extension
description: Chat with one or more Hermes instances over SSH or HTTP, switch profiles and inspect scheduled jobs inside Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Hermes chat, profiles and cron inspection
interface.longDescription: Work with Hermes through a Codex-styled chat interface. Expand profile sections with Hermes avatars, select a conversation model and reasoning effort, and inspect cron jobs and past runs on local or remote Hermes.
defaultPrompt: Show the available Hermes connections and profiles.
Inspect the cron jobs for my selected Hermes profile.
